title: Austin: Development Rights vs. Spring Protection
summary:
*   **New Development Rules for Annexed Areas:** The primary focus was an ordinance establishing development criteria for areas annexed in late 1997.
*   **Streamlined Developer Approvals:** This ordinance proposed administrative approval for projects and allowed developers to assert "vested rights," potentially fast-tracking construction.
*   **Overriding Environmental Protections:** A significant part of the proposal aimed to supersede existing disputed development regulations, notably the "Save Our Springs" (SOS) watershed protection ordinance.

CITY OF AUSTIN
FOUNDED 1839
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
April 22, 1998
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, noting the presence of all Councilmembers.
Consider an ordinance that establishes specific criteria, procedures, and regulations to

administrative approval of development projects where the developer may assert a vested
right to complete construction; and superseding disputed development regulations including
without limitation the "SOS" Save Our
